posts.bluesky: 📘 Never commented on a federal rule? How to Comment on Federal Rules is a plain-English guide to the Federal Register and Regulations.gov, and how to write a comment agencies have to consider. Kindle: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HP8V1ZFG

✍️ Agencies don't count votes; they respond to specific, well-supported comments. The Public Comment Workbook walks you through writing one, step by step. Paperback: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HLH5HVSV
⏰ Comment windows close fast. The Federal Register Tracker is a logbook for the rules you follow: dates, deadlines, what you did and how it turned out. Paperback: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HLHGT7C3
📖 Already commented? After the Comment covers what comes next: tracking a rule, petitioning an agency, and challenging a final rule. Kindle: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HLJ9CBR5
🗳 Every federal rule open for public comment, with deadlines and a link to the official comment page, updated daily. Free, plain English, not legal advice: https://fedregintel.com/rules/
